mission.title: The Power of Propaganda
mission.description: Tear down Morpheus' posters around the City.

phase.briefing: Morpheus and his followers have been putting up subversive posters around the City. We're concerned that these posters will create confusion among bluepills and possibly irritate the Machines, so we would like you to tear them down. While this may be a simple task, Warrior, it is important to Zion and has an impact on the strength of the Truce.

enter.say: Six of Morpheus' posters have been seen in that building. Find the posters and tear them down.

done.say: It appears that Morpheus' posters are appealing to these Exiles. This could mean trouble if we allow the posters to remain visible!

complete.say: Good work. Now go outside and I'll give you the address of another site where the posters have been found.

phase.briefing: I'm updating your waypoint with the location of another building in which Morpheus' posters have been found. We need the posters there torn down as well.

enter.say: Supposedly there are four posters in that building. Exiles appear to have turned the area into a small base since the posters were put up, and I'm seeing indications that they've put a security system in place, so be careful.

complete.say: You've taken care of all the posters in the area, {player}! You can leave now.

mission.finish: Removing those posters should help calm things down in the City. Our next step will be stopping Morpheus' poster crew before they can put up more of these misleading messages. Peace in the City depends upon our efforts!
